# ADR-3043: A04: Client-only authorization decision for feature 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Client checks are bypassable.

## Decision

Products SHALL NOT rely on a client-only authorization decision for feature 7 (A04-7) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Server re-validates every sensitive action.
